t: Found living in nether quartz nests in the nether. Crystalline Bees prefer pollinating something containing or made from nether quartz..
栖息在下界的下界石英蜂巢中。石英蜜蜂更喜欢为含有下界石英或由下界石英制成的东西授粉。
Found living in nether quartz nests in the nether. Glowing Bees prefer pollinating something containing nether quartz..
栖息在下界的下界石英蜂巢中。发光蜜蜂偏好授粉含下界石英的东西。
